content_of_post_to_answer: What is your daily routine? I want to fix my routine.
answer: A routine is not just a list of habits; it is a reflection of what your life is currently organized around. Many people try to copy someone else's schedule and fail because the structure does not match their priorities, energy, or responsibilities. Start by noticing what already happens consistently, then design around that reality. I've explored this pattern of building routines around identity and constraints in more detail on my profile, if you want to go deeper. The best routine is not the most impressive one; it is the one that quietly makes the life you want easier to live.
